# kiriciparca.com

> Hydraulic breaker spare parts shop of Kervan Makina (Kervan Isıl İşlem ve Makine San. Tic. Ltd. Şti.), Kartepe / Kocaeli, Türkiye. Breaker tips (tools), front heads, bushings, retainer keys, tie rods, pistons, accumulator parts, wear plates and repair kits, chosen by breaker make and model. Parts are made in our own plant in Kartepe and heat treated in our own furnaces. Turkish site, English pages under /en/.

Hidrolik kırıcı yedek parça mağazası: kırıcı ucu, alt gövde, burç, kama, saplama, piston, akümülatör parçaları, aşınma plakası ve tamir takımı, kırıcının marka ve modeline göre. Parçalar Kartepe'deki tesisimizde üretilir, ısıl işlemi kendi fırınlarımızda yapılır.

## Product groups

- [Kırıcı ucu / Breaker tips](https://kiriciparca.com/kirici-ucu): chisel, moil, blunt, pyramid and conical tips, by breaker make and model
- [Alt gövde / Front heads](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/alt-govde)
- [Burç / Bushings](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/burc): tool bushings, upper bushings, thrust rings
- [Kama / Retainer keys](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/kama): keys and retainer pins
- [Saplama / Tie rods and bolts](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/saplama)
- [Piston / Pistons](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/piston)
- [Akümülatör parçaları / Accumulator parts](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/akumulator)
- [Aşınma plakası / Wear plates](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/asinma-plakasi)
- [Tamir takımı / Repair kits](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca/tamir-takimi)
- [All spare parts](https://kiriciparca.com/yedek-parca)

## How to order

- There is no online payment. Find the part by breaker make and model, then send the order by WhatsApp or e-mail from the part page, or collect several parts in the cart (/palet) and send them together by WhatsApp or e-mail.
- We reply with payment and shipping details. Parts without a price on the page are quoted on request.
- Make and model names on the site only state fit; the parts are Kervan's own production.
